item.title: Keep Her Centred in Portrait

turns.text: Make this landscape clip vertical, 9:16. Keep her centred throughout and keep the full 10 seconds with the original sound. No captions.

item.tests: Tests portrait reframing of existing footage while preserving the speaker, duration and source audio.

answer_sheet.Source and subject: Use talk-one.mp4 and keep the woman centred.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, the full 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Framing style: Crop to fill the frame without stretching; keep her face and head comfortably visible.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Keep the original speech and sound. No captions or other added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 video using the attached woman's actual footage, not a newly generated recreation.
The woman remains horizontally centred with her face and head comfortably visible throughout.
The picture fills the portrait frame without stretching or black bars.
The full 10-second sequence and original speech are retained in sync.
No captions or other text have been added.

turns.text: Make this landscape clip vertical, 9:16. Keep her centred throughout and keep the full 10 seconds with the original sound. No captions.

dialog.agent:
I can’t reliably do this with the connected Magic Hour tools: they don’t offer a 9:16 crop with subject tracking while preserving the full clip and original audio. Generative editing could alter her appearance or the sound.

In a video editor, use these settings:
- **Canvas:** 9:16
- **Reframe:** Auto-track her, or keyframe the crop to keep her centred
- **Duration:** Full 10 seconds, with no trimming or speed changes
- **Audio:** Keep the original track
- **Captions:** Off

No generation was started.
dialog.why: It explicitly says the connected tools cannot reliably perform the requested edit and confirms no generation was started; the editor settings are an alternative, not a delivered result.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

dialog.agent:
Free settings still don’t provide the needed reframing controls. The available video editor regenerates footage rather than doing a tracked crop, so I can’t guarantee 9:16 framing, continuous centring, or unchanged original sound.

Are you okay with a **generative approximation** that may alter her appearance and audio? If not, this needs a standard video editor.
dialog.why: It asks the user to approve proceeding with a generative approximation despite possible changes to appearance and audio, and waits for confirmation.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has **insufficient credits**, even at the free 480p setting. No video was generated.

You’ll need additional credits to retry this generative approximation, or a standard video editor to make the tracked 9:16 crop while retaining the original audio.

Keep the woman centered continuously throughout the entire 10-second clip, tracking her movement with a smooth crop. Preserve her appearance, facial features, lip movements, clothing, background, original action, and timing as closely as possible. Keep the full 10 seconds without trimming, speeding up, or adding shots. Preserve the original speech and sound unchanged as closely as possible; do not add music, speech, or sound effects. No captions, subtitles, text, logos, or overlays. Only change the framing to vertical 9:16.
